Test-only files of the e2e package.

- `htmx-4.0.1.min.js`: htmx 4.0.1, `dist/htmx.min.js` of the npm package `htmx.org@4.0.1`, unmodified.
- `htmx-2.0.11.min.js`: htmx 2.0.11, `dist/htmx.min.js` of the npm package `htmx.org@2.0.11`, unmodified.

Both are under the BSD Zero Clause License (0BSD), copyright Big Sky Software. They're served to the test browser only, never shipped.

- `site/`: the fixture project the CSP test builds with `lyr build`.
